$:set -euo pipefail
echo 'HEAD'; git rev-parse HEAD
for f in workspaces/programs/scratchpad/Scratchpad-selection.json workspaces/programs/scratchpad/scratchpad-interface.test.js workspaces/programs/scratchpad/scratchpad.js workspaces/programs/scratchpad/SRS.md workspaces/programs/scratchpad/SRS.agent.json; do
 echo "FILE:$f"
 if git cat-file -e "HEAD:$f" 2>/dev/null; then echo 'CHECKOUT_HAS_FILE=yes'; git show "HEAD:$f" | sha256sum; else echo 'CHECKOUT_HAS_FILE=no'; fi
 if gh api "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$f" --jq .sha >/tmp/meta-sha 2>/tmp/meta-error; then echo 'REMOTE_HAS_FILE=yes'; cat /tmp/meta-sha; gh api "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$f" --jq .content | tr -d '\n' | base64 -d | sha256sum; else echo 'REMOTE_HAS_FILE=no'; head -2 /tmp/meta-error; fi
done
echo 'REMOTE INTRO HEAD'
gh api repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/workspaces/programs/scratchpad/Scratchpad-selection.json --jq .content | tr -d '\n' | base64 -d | head -50
echo 'REMOTE COMMITS'
gh api repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/commits --jq '.[0:4][]|(.sha+" "+.commit.message)'
